verdict: Qualcomm grew revenue 17% to $11.0B as handset chips rebounded 12% and its car and connected-device chips surged, with automotive up 59%.

segments.name: QCT
segments.note: The chip business. Inside it: Handsets $6,929M (+12% YoY), Automotive $959M (+59%), IoT $1,581M (+27%).

segments.name: QTL
segments.note: Licensing phone makers to use Qualcomm's patents — very high margin (70% pre-tax EBT margin).

segments.name: Other and reconciling items
segments.note: Includes $143M of licensing revenue from a recent dispute settlement, not allocated to segments; the difference between segment revenue and the reported total.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building chips, modems and AI platforms; down 1% YoY.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling, legal costs and running the company; flat YoY.

footerNote: Qualcomm guided Q3 FY25 revenue to $9.9B–$10.7B and non-GAAP EPS to $2.60–$2.80.
pngFooterNote: Qualcomm guided Q3 FY25 revenue to $9.9B–$10.7B.
otherDetail: Investment and other income of $148M, less $163M of interest expense, makes up the $15M outside operations.

takeaways.title: Diversification is accelerating
takeaways.text: Automotive and IoT combined grew 38% YoY to $2.54B — Automotive surged 59% to $959M and IoT rose 27% to $1.58B — as Qualcomm's push beyond phones kept paying off.

takeaways.title: Handsets still the engine
takeaways.text: Handset chips brought in $6.93B, up 12% YoY and 63% of total revenue, inside QCT's $9.47B (+18%). QTL licensing was flat at $1.32B.

takeaways.title: Cash back to shareholders
takeaways.text: Qualcomm returned $2.7B to shareholders in the quarter — $1.7B of buybacks (11 million shares) plus $938M of dividends — and guided Q3 FY25 revenue to $9.9B–$10.7B.

oneTimers: GAAP revenue includes $143M of licensing revenue from a recent settlement of a licensing dispute, not allocated to segment results and excluded from non-GAAP revenue.
Operating expenses include $34M of gains from revaluing deferred compensation plan liabilities, offset by $34M of losses on the related plan assets inside investment income — the two cancel out.

Non-GAAP results also exclude $703M of share-based compensation and $53M of acquisition-related charges; the tax line includes a $100M benefit from the foreign-derived intangible income deduction tied to capitalized R&D.

sources.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 30, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
